newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne unit to sell PVC film business.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne unit to sell PVC film business.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said Friday its wholly owned Viskase Corp subsidiary signed a non-binding letter of intent to sell its PVC flexible film business to LINPAC Plastics Ltd.
Under the letter of intent, LINPAC will acquire the assets used in Viskase's plants in Aurora, Ohio, and Sedgefield, England.

The purchase is subject to completion of due diligence, receipt of any necessary governmental approvals and execution of a definitive purchase agreement. The deal is expected to be completed within the next 90 days.
Envirodyne said Viskase's global specialty film and casings business will not be included in the sale, adding Viskase will concentrate its resources on further building those core businesses.
